rows.explanation: E2 allocator artifact of the in-process sample loop: after the untimed projection, glibc returns freed memory to the kernel, so the next timed open re-faults about 2,700 pages (10.5 MiB). Which leg lands in that mode depends on the leg's projection and the process layout (without the GNU time wrapper the leaf lifecycle was the slow one). With malloc trimming off and a fixed mmap threshold: unified 1,899 us vs pre-M0a 1,932 us; bare open loop: unified 1,684 us vs leaf 1,680 us.
